plans.525792: Zor Awar top the Sunday 3 table (1st of 9, 4 wins from 6, won 4 of their last 5) and beat The Supernovas on Sun 8 Nov; you've never batted against them. It's a 07:45 start the morning after the Saturday game: since 2024 you strike at 108 in early games and 112 as the second game of the weekend (29 innings), against your usual 122. LMS now lists Qasim Qadir as their top batter and bowler; no bowler on their books has dismissed you. The Mustangs have loaded their line-up with you in it; Zor Awar haven't loaded theirs yet, and umpires aren't named.
plans.525944: Hit and Run JHB are 6th of 16 and won four in a row before Marlboro Maestros bowled them out cheaply on Sat 7 Nov (67/7, lost by 6 wickets). You've struggled against them: 106 runs at 15.1 in 7 innings, and only one score over 15 (45 off 20 on Sat 10 May 2025); none of their current top players has dismissed you. The 07:45 start is a weak slot for you since 2024 (strike rate 108 over 23 innings against your usual 122), but Zoo Lake Bottom is one of your better grounds (average 30.7 over 30 innings against 24.9). Neither side has loaded a line-up yet and umpires aren't named.

oneThing.title: Stop getting bowled
oneThing.why: 12 of your last 14 dismissals were bowled, the latest by Naved Nakedar for 46 off 38 on Sat 7 Nov (Sun 8 Nov was a run out for 4 off 5). Since 2024 you've been out for under 10 in 29 of 104 innings, so staying in your stance and playing straight is worth more runs than any new shot.

drills.how: Every ball goes back between mid-off and mid-on, defended or driven. Don't move until the ball is released, then let your front pad and bat come down together. A teammate at square leg calls out if your back foot moves towards leg.
drills.name: Back past the machine
drills.success: 25 of 30 go back down the ground and none hit the stumps.

nets.goal: Same focus, still light: hold your stance and hit it straight. Both early starts this weekend (07:45 Sat and Sun) are where you score slowest, so get your eye in quickly. About 20 minutes on the machine, plus 10 at home.

home.how: In front of a mirror or a window at night, side-on. Take your stance, hold still for a count of two, then play 10 straight drives and 10 forward defences in slow motion. Check your head stays over your front knee and your back foot doesn't slide towards leg.
home.success: 20 clean reps where your back foot stays put.

machine: Good length: lands about 6 m from your stumps

503438.saw: LMS has no clip for this ball, so there's nothing to break down. You were set: 39 off 27 before being bowled.

504778.fix: Only go aerial when your front foot reaches the pitch. Otherwise drive along the ground through cover. At 30 off 23 in the 9th over you were already scoring at 130; you didn't need the risk.
504778.saw: The camera is behind you. You're upright in your stance, then the bat goes up and through high towards the off side: a lofted drive. You finish high and still upright rather than over the ball, so it goes up, not long, and it's caught. You were 30 off 23 in the 9th over, the ball after a four.
504778.wrong: Going over the top without getting to the pitch of the ball. Hitting on the rise from a tall position sends it up, not far.

525770.fix: With a partner going at 200+, your job was to rotate the strike and get him on it. If you do swing, swing with a vertical bat at the straight ball, over the bowler's head, not across it.
525770.saw: In your stance at release, then the backlift goes almost straight up, a short crouch, and the bat comes through low and whips round to finish high and across your body. It's a cross-bat heave, and the ball goes under or past it into the stumps. You were 24 off 27 in the 17th over; Brandon at the other end was 34 off 16.
525770.wrong: A cross-bat slog at a straight ball, trying to make up a slow innings (SR 86) in one shot.

525775.saw: LMS has no clip for this ball, so there's nothing to break down. You were set: 30 off 26 before being bowled.

525779.fix: When you decide to hit, get the front foot to the pitch and swing straight down the ground (between mid-off and mid-on). After a big over, the next ball doesn't need to be a boundary: at 23 off 11 a single keeps the over going.
525779.saw: You're still in your stance as Mansoor lands. Then a very high backlift and a full swing that finishes high over your shoulder. You stay tall and your front foot doesn't travel towards the ball, so the bat comes down from a long way up and the ball beats it into the stumps. This was the over after 4, 4, 6, and you were 23 off 11.
525779.wrong: Swinging hard from a planted base at a ball on the stumps. With no stride to the pitch, the bat crosses the line of the ball instead of going through it.

525931.saw: The camera is a long way off. You lift the bat high, then lean forward with your arms stretched low in front as the ball arrives, and it beats the bat into the stumps. Too far away to tell whether it was a drive or a swing across the line. You were 30 off 23, first ball of the 11th over.

525938.saw: The camera is a long way off and the players are too small to make out the shot. You were bowled by Naved Nakedar for 46 off 38, first ball of the 14th over.

outTakes.pattern: All of your last 7 dismissals came once you were set (23 to 46 runs), and 6 were bowled. The 3 clear on camera were all big swings, not defensive errors: 2 slogs across the line that missed and hit the stumps, 1 lofted drive that went up instead of long. The 31 Oct and 7 Nov clips are too far away to judge.
